# rambutan <a href="http://drmowinckels.io/rambutan/"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" alt="rambutan website" /></a>

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/drmowinckels/rambutan/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/drmowinckels/rambutan/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![coverage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drmowinckels/rambutan/coverage/badges/coverage.svg)](https://github.com/drmowinckels/rambutan/actions/workflows/test-coverage.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

rambutan is an R interface to [lychee](https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee), a fast, async link checker written in Rust. It wraps `lychee-lib` via [extendr](https://extendr.github.io/) to check URLs, files, and directories for broken links, and to scan an R package's own sources for broken URLs the way `R CMD check --as-cran` and CRAN's incoming checks do.

## Installation

rambutan is not yet on CRAN. You can install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("drmowinckels/rambutan")
```

Building rambutan requires Cargo and rustc (Rust's package manager and compiler); see [rustup.rs](https://rustup.rs/) for installation instructions.

## Example

Check a single URL:

```{r example}
library(rambutan)
check_url("https://www.r-project.org")
```

Check several URLs concurrently:

```{r check-urls}
check_urls(c("https://www.r-project.org", "https://cran.r-project.org"))
```

Scan a file or directory for links and check every one found:

```{r check-paths, eval = FALSE}
check_paths("README.md")
```

Scan an R package's own sources (`DESCRIPTION`, Rd files, `NEWS.md`, `CITATION`, vignettes) for URLs, mirroring CRAN's own URL check:

```{r check-package, eval = FALSE}
check_package(".")
```
